title: BoatsJumper
description: BoatsJumper does exactly what the name says: makes boats jump!
body:
# BoatsJumper — Paper 26.1 Compatibility Fork

An unofficial compatibility maintenance build of BoatsJumper updated for modern Minecraft server versions.

This fork preserves the original plugin functionality while fixing compatibility issues with Paper 26.1.x and Java 25.

## Original Plugin

Full credit goes to MajliTech for creating the original BoatsJumper plugin.

Original resource:
https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/boatsjumper.127306/

## What Was Updated

* Updated deprecated boat entity handling for modern Minecraft versions
* Fixed compatibility issues with newer Paper APIs
* Rebuilt using Gradle and Java 25
* Tested on Paper 26.1.x servers

## Supported Platforms

* Paper 26.1.x
* Purpur 26.1.x

## Notes

This project is intended purely as a compatibility maintenance fork for server owners wanting to continue using BoatsJumper on newer Minecraft versions.

The original gameplay and plugin behavior have intentionally been kept unchanged.
